description: One model's file inventory with paths, sizes, SHA-256 and hosting, plus runKit tested commands when Hugging Bay has run that exact file. Use when you need the file inventory, optionally filtered by local runner; commands appear only with a tested run path. Example: {"id":"hf-model-qwen-qwen3-0-6b-gguf"}. Reads records; does not change files.

cursor.description: Page cursor returned by the previous read.

id.description: Artifact or record id returned by a previous read.

limit.description: Maximum number of returned rows; use the stated bounds.

tool.description: Local runner or tool to select from the allowed choices.

name: list_files
title: List files
